description: Delta Air Lines, Inc. is a global airline based in the United States that connects customers across its expansive global network with a commitment to ensuring that the future of travel is connected, personalized and enjoyable, having served over 200 million customers in 2025 safely, reliably and with industry-leading customer service innovation. In its centennial year in 2025 it continued to differentiate itself from the industry and invest in extending its enduring competitive advantages, which support its trusted consumer brand and include its people and culture, operational reliability, global network, customer loyalty and financial foundation, with more than 100,000 employees providing world-class travel experiences, and it operates an award-winning SkyMiles loyalty program.
